title: Pure Trade brings disco-ball sparkle to Rabanne's Advent calendar
summary: The case housing the 24 beauty treats — including fragrances, makeup, travel-size products and accessories — is designed as a collectible disco ball, which was developed by Pure Trade. Inspired by the House's metallic brilliance, the ball is injection moulded and faceted with square panels in relief, whose printed decoration recreates the glitter of a mirror ball.
